reason: Each SAFE row ends in an empty button (no text, label or title) that exposes as button with no name; it fails 4.1.2. Tab reaches the three of them in a row, and Enter on the first opens the Logan Roy detail drawer with the shareable link and the SAFE document. Rows have no link or tabindex, so for keyboard and screen-reader users this unnamed button is the only way to a SAFE's details, and the guidance rates a sole primary action high.
